description: List the values a card `field` accepts in a language, which search_cards' filters take. `contains` filters them case-insensitively before paging; read further pages while `hasMore` is true. Values come from upstream as they are, so near-identical spellings of one artist can both appear.

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring, applied to the whole field before paging, e.g. 'arita' finds 'Mitsuhiro Arita'.

field.description: The card field to list values for. 'type' is a Pokémon card's type (Fire, Water, …); 'energy' is an Energy card's class (Normal or Special); 'category' is the kind of card (Pokemon, Trainer or Energy); 'variant' is a printing the card exists in (normal, holo, reverse, firstEdition).

language.description: Catalogue language. Names, values and set lists are localised (the Asian catalogues have their own set ids), so look values up in it; prices are the same in every language.

page.description: Zero-indexed page. A page past the end is an empty success with `hasMore` false.

size.description: Results per page; only `hasMore` says whether more exist.

name: list_card_field_values

hasMore.description: True when at least one further page of results exists after this one. Request every result by incrementing 'page' until this is false. There is deliberately no total count: the length of the returned array is the size of this page.

language.description: The catalogue language this response was read in.

page.description: The zero-indexed page of results this response holds, whether it was requested or defaulted to.

size.description: The page size this response was built with, whether it was requested or defaulted to. It is the maximum number of results this page can hold, not the number it does hold — the last page holds fewer.

values.description: One page of the field's accepted values, in the requested language, after any 'contains' filter. Pass a value back as listed when filtering a card search. Values come from the upstream data as-is and are not de-duplicated, so near-identical spellings can both appear — 'Souchirou Gunjima' and 'Souichirou Gunjima' are the same illustrator. Prefer a partial 'contains' search over guessing an exact spelling.

anyOf.description: A textual value, e.g. a rarity or illustrator name
A numeric value, e.g. an HP or Pokédex number
